name: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
description: The Boss Baby brings his big brother Tim to the office to teach him the art of business in this animated series sprung from the hit film.

videos.title: Scooter Buskie
videos.overview: The constantly crying "worst baby in the world" is making life miserable for all of his neighbors.  Can Boss Baby's field team turn things around?

videos.title: Cat's in the Cradle
videos.overview: Competition for cuteness heats up when a stray kitten appears on the Templetons' doorstep and the family decides to take him in.

videos.title: Family Fun Night
videos.overview: Family Fun NIght turns into Baby Work Night when trouble follows the Templetons to the grand opening of a seemingly purr-fect restaurant.

videos.title: Formula for Menace: A Dekker Moonboots Mystery
videos.overview: Tim's alter ego, space detective Dekker Moonboots, steps in to solve a Baby Corp mystery -- and mounting clues suggest it's an inside job.

videos.title: Monster Machine
videos.overview: The Field team enters one of their own in the prestigious Lil' Dumpling Pageant to make sure the winner is someone Baby Corp can trust.

videos.title: The Constipation Situation
videos.overview: A backed-up Boss Baby is forced to take a sick day when his system stalls -- and he can't go boom-boom. Now it's up to tim ti take over.

videos.title: The Boss Babysitter
videos.overview: The brothers stay home with a babysitter while their parents go out for the night.  Boss Baby wants to make her look bad -- but she's just too good.

videos.title: Into the Belly of the Den of the House of the Nest of Cats
videos.overview: While Tim works overtime to do good in the neighborhood, Staci and Boss Baby go undercover to rescue Jimbo from a house that's crawling with cats.

videos.title: Spirit Day
videos.overview: The team suits up to stop Mega FAT CEO Baby from winning an office spirit day contest that's totally rigged.  Because nobody likes a bully.

videos.title: Par Avion
videos.overview: A "free" family vacation comes at a cost when Tim's tasked with keeping a plane full of babies calm on an eight-hour flight to Paris.

videos.title: Cat Cop!
videos.overview: The Templetons cross paths with a "Cat Cop" with connections to cunning villain Bootsy Calico.  Tim masters the art of negotiation.

videos.title: Hang in There, Baby
videos.overview: An after-hours break-in to save Boss Baby's job transforms a do-gooding Tim into the daring Tim Templeton: Unleashed.

videos.title: Six Well-Placed Kittens
videos.overview: With Bootsy Calico's plan in full swing, Boss Baby rallies his co-workers to bring Calico and his kittens down and save the town.

videos.title: As the Diaper Changes
videos.overview: The new Baby Corp CEO gives Boss Baby a big assignment. Meanwhile, Tim's feisty grandmother moves in, turning the brothers into temporary roommates.

videos.title: Super Cool Big Kids Inc.
videos.overview: After declaring war on old people, Boss Baby focuses the field team's efforts on Frederic Estes. Tim starts his own big-kid business.

videos.title: P.U.
videos.overview: When Baby Corp's lead scientist accidentally turns the stinkless serum into a stink enhancer, Boss Baby needs Tim's help to freshen things up.

videos.title: Hush, Little Baby
videos.overview: An innocent trip to the library for toddler story hour sparks a turf war between babydom and Frederic Estes's Consortium of Ancients.

videos.title: Night of the Frodarg
videos.overview: On a dark and stormy night, Tim and Boss Baby set traps for two wildly different threats: a mythical monster and a Puppy Co. agent named Bug the Pug.

videos.title: Fugitive's Day Out
videos.overview: After being framed for the Puppy Co. leak, a fugitive Boss Baby goes on the lam and comes face to face with an old corporate rival.

videos.title: The Passionate Nanny Business
videos.overview: When Frederic Estes and his friends monopolize Marisol's talents for elder care, Boss Baby and Tim team up to get their babysitter back.

videos.title: Plushythingy
videos.overview: The Consortium of Ancients floods the market with an irresistibly fluffy new toy that has babies going gaga -- a little too gaga.

videos.title: Number One Problem
videos.overview: Gigi's potty training strategy has a diaperless Boss Baby hanging out in the buff. But a horrified Tim can't handle all the nakey time.

videos.title: Picture Perfect
videos.overview: With the Templeton men away on a "Dudes Weekend," Staci and Jimbo join forces to return a blankie to its rightful owner.

videos.title: Play It Again, Tim
videos.overview: Tim's parents enroll him in piano lessons for the rest of the summer. But Boss Baby suspects Tim's "lessons" are part of a larger Frederic Estes plot.

videos.title: Research & Development
videos.overview: With Baby Corp's stinkless serum in enemy hands, Turtleneck Superstar CEO Baby issues a challenge to deliver a new formula by 5 p.m.

videos.title: Wrinkles & Stinkles
videos.overview: In the wake of Tim's discovery, a newly crowned Boss Baby seizes the chance to show his team what a real leader looks like.

videos.title: Bossa Nova
videos.overview: Ousted from the office and desperate for direction, an unemployed Boss Baby joins a mommy/daddy and me playgroup. But he isn't the only new member.

videos.title: The Museum Job
videos.overview: A long line at the museum's family bathroom sends baby love into the toilet. Can the field team evict the potty squatter and get things moving?

videos.title: Ga Ba Goo Ba Ga (The Babblist)
videos.overview: While the Boss Baby helps Tim sell magazines for a school fundraiser, a suspicious baby whisperer is breaking up the playgroup ... but why?

videos.title: The Coo Chi Coup
videos.overview: The stage is set for corporate sabotage when Staci sends the Boss Baby undercover to take down Baby Corp's latest leader at a company retreat.

videos.title: Lights, Camera, Org Chart!
videos.overview: Unruly baby Scooter Buskie sends shockwaves through the playgroup org chart — and all of babydom — when he lands the cover of the Bubbeezee catalog.

videos.title: The Big Break
videos.overview: A broken bone sends the Boss Baby to a wisecracking doctor who fancies himself a comedian. In other news, Tim's lucky pencil is cursed.

videos.title: Escape from Krinkle's
videos.overview: Boss Baby has an interview at Baby Corp — but first, he'll need to break out of a high-tech Bubbeezee playroom. Can the field team help him escape?

videos.title: Puppy Party
videos.overview: A party in the park drags the Boss Baby into a dogfight with his old nemesis, Puppy Co.'s Bug the Pug — and the loser must don the "Collar of Shame."

videos.title: Mega Fat
videos.overview: A flashback episode reveals everything that happened to Mega Fat between getting fired from Baby Corp and getting adopted by a famous journalist.

videos.title: Halloween
videos.overview: Halloween is the perfect cover for the Boss Baby and his costumed field team to sneak into the belly of the beast. But Staci's got plans to stop them.

videos.title: Who's a Good Baby?
videos.overview: Baby love has never been higher. But a crash is coming, and the Boss Baby and his crew are determined to bring Bubbeezee down for good.

videos.title: Yellow 100
videos.overview: As the newly named CEO, the Boss Baby sets a goal for baby love to hit 100%. But now everyone's working overtime to please him.

videos.title: Pyg & Tam
videos.overview: The Boss Baby declares war on a new threat: a popular TV show starring a pygmy goat, a tamandua and their human handler.

videos.title: Conference Room B
videos.overview: Company morale is so low that the Boss Baby throws a last-minute cupcake party, then sends a manager to help Tim handle some family business.

videos.title: Game Plan
videos.overview: Boss Baby's next scheme to increase baby love? A petition to change the local soccer team's name from the Hive to the Babies.

videos.title: Night Owls
videos.overview: After sneaking into a grown-up movie, Tim decides he's mature enough for the adult world. Meanwhile, Boss Baby sleeps over at a friend's house.

videos.title: OCB
videos.overview: It's the Boss Baby's worst nightmare when a consultant comes to Baby Corp with zany ideas, then sets his sights on the CEO's job.

videos.title: Chicago
videos.overview: On a trip to the Windy City to see Gigi and Grandpa, the Boss Baby comes face to face with an ambitious infant who's masquerading as an adult.

videos.title: Baby Boss
videos.overview: The Boss Baby's away at a checkup, so it's up to interim manager Staci to fend off three wars: one from Pyg & Tam, one from OCB and one from Bug the Pug.

videos.title: Boom Baby
videos.overview: Boss Baby discovers an old Mega Fat initiative called Project Boom — and it's threatening to ruin baby rights everywhere.

videos.title: The Fumbling of Football Mike
videos.overview: After the Boss Baby accidentally sells Tim's favorite toy at a yard sale, he uses company resources to try and get it back.

videos.title: Teambuilding
videos.overview: Baby Corp is dismantled and comms are down, but that won't stop the Boss Baby from rallying to reunite his employees. Tim spends one last day with Danny.

videos.title: Theo 100
videos.overview: With diapers piling up in the Templetons' basement, the Boss Baby crafts a plan to break into Baby Corp, kick out his enemies and take his business back.
